episodeTitle.en: Growth tactics, retention strategies, and becoming a better writer | Julian Shapiro (Demand Curve, Hyper, Webflow, TechCrunch)
episodeTitle.zh: 朱利安·夏皮罗（Julian Shapiro）：增长策略、留存策略与提升写作能力 | （Demand Curve、Hyper、Webflow、TechCrunch）

guestBioOfficial.en: Julian Shapiro is widely known as the founder of Demand Curve, where he’s helped thousands of companies figure out their growth strategy. He also wrote the growth marketing column at TechCrunch, was VP of Marketing at Webflow, and even created an animation engine called Velocity that’s now used in apps like Uber and WhatsApp. In today’s episode, Julian dives deep on product-led acquisition (PLA) and why he believes it’s the best way to grow your company. He shares specific marketing strategies for growth and retention and speaks about his framework for creating novel, engaging content, and how to choose topics for that content. He also discusses a framework called the Curiosity Faucet, inspired by prolific creators such as Ed Sheeran, John Mayer, Taylor Swift, and Neil Gaiman, to help you unlock your own creativity.
guestBioOfficial.zh: 朱利安·夏皮罗（Julian Shapiro）是Demand Curve的创始人，他帮助数千家公司制定增长战略。他还为TechCrunch撰写了增长营销专栏，曾担任Webflow的营销副总裁，甚至创建了名为Velocity的动画引擎，该引擎现已应用于Uber和WhatsApp等应用程序。在今天的节目中，朱利安深入探讨了产品主导型收购（PLA），并解释了为什么他认为这是发展公司的最佳方式。他分享了具体的增长和留存营销策略，并谈到了他创建新颖、引人入胜内容的框架，以及如何为这些内容选择主题。他还讨论了一个名为"好奇心水龙头"的框架，该框架灵感来自Ed Sheeran、John Mayer、Taylor Swift和Neil Gaiman等多产创作者，帮助你释放自己的创造力。

title.en: Growth tactics, retention strategies, and becoming a better writer | Julian Shapiro (Demand Curve, Hyper, Webflow, TechCrunch)
title.zh: 朱利安·夏皮罗（Julian Shapiro）：增长策略、留存策略与提升写作能力 | （Demand Curve、Hyper、Webflow、TechCrunch）

summary.en: Julian makes the case for product-led acquisition (PLA) as the most durable and capital-efficient way to grow a company. He shares concrete tactics for improving retention and a framework for producing novel, engaging content, including the "Curiosity Faucet" creativity method. The episode also covers how to pick topics and write in a way that earns attention.
summary.zh: 朱利安主张"产品驱动获取"（PLA）是公司最持久、最具资金效率的增长方式。他分享了提升留存的具体策略，以及创作新颖、有吸引力内容的框架，包括"好奇心水龙头"这一激发创造力的方法。本期还涉及如何选题，以及如何写出真正能赢得注意力的内容。
